tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Get a free API key for this server (no account needed; 25 email verifications per day). Returns the key once — reconnect with 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' to use the other tools.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Get the current credit balance and a short usage summary for the account.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List the user's bulk verification lists/jobs, most recent first.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get the details of a single bulk verification list by its id.

tools.name: explain_result
tools.description: Explain what a verification status or reason means in plain English, with a send recommendation. Covers valid, invalid, catch-all/accept-all, unknown, greylisted, disposable, role, free, spam-trap, abuse, do-not-mail, no-mx, disabled, and network. Use when a user asks what a result means.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Verify the deliverability of a single email address. Returns a verdict (valid, invalid, risky, unknown). Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: verify_batch
tools.description: Verify a batch of email addresses (up to 25 per call with an agent key). Returns per-email verdicts and saves a list. Costs 1 credit per email.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of a verification before running it, and whether the user can afford it. Provide either a count of emails, a list_id to re-verify, or an operation ('single'/'finder'). Always quote this before proposing anything billable.

tools.name: get_batch_status
tools.description: Get the progress and status of a bulk verification list/job by id.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_api_key" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get a free API key for this server (no account needed; 25 email verifications per day). Returns the key once — reconnect with 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_api_key, verify_batch · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key, explain_result, verify_email, verify_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_api_key, verify_batch · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key, explain_result, verify_email, verify_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
